# SHA-256 of the o4 release archives CI downloads, for the release named by
# runtime_version in compatibility.toml. CI refuses any download that does not
# match, so an archive replaced on the release page cannot slip in.
#
# When re-pinning the runtime, replace these lines with the new release's
# values, checked against the release's .sha256 files:
#   curl -fsSL <release>/<archive>.sha256
# The release must match the version line below.
#
